title: Gatekeeper policy document, version 2
description: Input to gatekeeper_configure(json := ...) or gatekeeper_validate(sql, json := ...). Configure replaces the global policy with defaults plus these options; validation applies these request options under the current global ceiling. Duplicate object keys are rejected by the decoder before schema validation could represent them.

$schema.description: Optional editor schema association; never fetched by Gatekeeper.

version.description: Document format version, independent of DuckDB and Gatekeeper releases.

use_default_functions.description: Use this installation's reviewed function defaults plus allowed_functions. False allows only allowed_functions. Defaults to true for configuration; validation inherits the global value when omitted.

allowed_functions.description: Resolved function grants. Defaults cover reviewed system.main identities only. '*' in name is multiplication, not a wildcard.

blocked_functions.description: Function leaf names to deny; denies win over allows.

allowed_tables.description: Allowed table/view identities. An empty array denies all tables/views. Omission leaves configuration unrestricted for non-internal objects, or inherits the global restriction during validation.

blocked_tables.description: Table/view identities to deny; denies win over allows.

name.description: Nonempty Unicode name without NUL or unpaired surrogates; ASCII case-insensitive.

table.description: '*' matches one whole component at exactly the specified schema depth, never recursively. Omitted or null catalog matches any catalog.
